items.title: LLMs corrupt your documents when you delegate
A recent experience with ChatGPT 5.5 Pro
Alisha-21-cloud/DiamondPriceX
items.abstract: DiamondPriceX is a full-stack web application that predicts the market price of a diamond based on its physical and qualitative attributes. The platform combines a trained machine learning model with a clean, modern web interface to deliver real-time price estimates.

items.title: DIDimov24/iForeSea-AquaSense-IoT-Hackathon
items.abstract: iForeSea is an early-warning web platform that uses machine learning to predict the risk of harmful algal blooms (HABs) in the coastal waters of Burgas Bay, Bulgaria, 3-5 days in advance.
